hints.title: Three Month Rolling Salary Summation
hints.text: Calculate the rolling sum of salaries for each employee over a window of up to 3 consecutive months, excluding each employee most recent month.

hints.title: Excluding Most Recent Month via Window Max
hints.text: Filter out the maximum month worked per employee using max(month) over(partition by id). Then compute sum(salary) over a range between 2 preceding and current row.

hints.title: Cumulative Salary Blueprint
hints.text: With Excluded as (select id, month, salary, max(month) over(partition by id) as max_m from Employee) select id, month, sum(salary) over(partition by id order by month range between 2 preceding and current row) as Salary from Excluded where month < max_m order by id asc, month desc.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH Filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        month,
        salary,
        MAX(month) OVER(PARTITION BY id) AS max_month
    FROM Employee
)
SELECT 
    id,
    month,
    SUM(salary) OVER(
        PARTITION BY id 
        ORDER BY month 
        RANGE BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS Salary
FROM Filtered
WHERE month < max_month
ORDER BY id ASC, month DESC;
```

variables: N: number of records in Employee table
complexity.notes: Window range aggregations and partition sorting execute in linear-logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Self-joins across 3 month offset combinations generate multiple intermediate cartesian products.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: RANGE BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING window frames compute exact monthly offsets without join explosion.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Using RANGE rather than ROWS to respect exact numeric month differences.
